action.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do sleep 30; echo "=== iter $i ==="; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}' 2>&1 | grep asr; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --since 2m asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -viE "DEBUG|httpcore|GPUWatchdog|monitor|it/s" | tail -8; echo "--- watch dir:"; ls -la watch/ | grep -vE "keep|jfk16k"; if ls watch/ 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "\.txt$|Transkript|\.vtt$|\.srt$"; then echo "TRANSCRIPT FOUND!"; break; fi; done
